record.title: microduck-bottom-head-shell
record.why: MEASURED 2026-09-02 (lane T): the shelf's own check FAILed this folder for declaring ZERO interfaces, and that is now settled — cad/interfaces.json declares two MEASURED anchors — 'head_shell_screws' (3 x Ø2.6950 x 2.0040 on a Ø112.1175 circle at (0.0000, 49.5000) and (+-39.0000, -49.5000), the two front positions adding a Ø6.9020 x 3.1450 boss with a Ø5.5000 x 2.8240 driver bore, and the same three (x, y) carry part:microduck-top-head-shell's Ø2.1000 pilots measured independently on the other mesh) and 'motor_support_screws' (4 x Ø2.2000 x 9.3000 pilots with Ø2.7900 x 0.7010 counterbores at exactly the four (x, y) of part:microduck-motor-support's own Ø2.7000 through-holes, again measured independently) — frozen in out/laneT/features/bottom_head_shell.json. WHAT IS STILL MISSING, named rather than left as 'nothing measured yet': cad/part.py is still the `bin/triad new part` SKELETON and builds no geometry. And this part sits under COMPARISON.html finding 1: its mate, top_head_shell, measures 122.6900 mm front-to-back against the compact domed head in every product photograph, so the head pair may be replaced wholesale. What settles it: lane A's head reconstruction, then a loader or graded rebuild here.
record.origin_why: the geometry this folder describes is Pollen Robotics' own published sim asset (reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/), measured but not designed here; CC BY-SA-NC 4.0 per the pollen-robotics/microduck_rl README, so usable to assemble, render, simulate and print, NOT licensed for sale.
